name: Spreadsheet Builder
description: Create a real XLSX workbook with formula totals and verify it reads back.

permissionsRequired.reason: Persist the document through the registered document tool.
Read the artifact back by the id the tool returned.
Read the persisted document back as text.

validation.rule: An .xlsx artifactId was persisted and artifact_get read the workbook back with size greater than 0. A markdown table is not a workbook.
